notes: Seven localized movable-part episodes are visible. The two leaves of each double-door closet are reported separately because they are distinct movable parts, although their closely spaced transitions make the individual leaf timings less certain.
scene_description: A first-person traversal through an apartment entry hall, coat closet, laundry closet, kitchen, and living area. The user opens and later closes two double-door closets, an integrated refrigerator, an upper spice cabinet, and a lower utensil drawer.
